Deprecation can be done in the future, in a few releases.

tACK facf53acf4

Tested on macOS 27.2 arm64 against master `4ef7904c39`.
The modified `wallet_listtransactions.py` test fails on master with `Unknown named parameter minimum_amount` and passes with this PR.
Manually checked all four aliases, both inside `query_options` and via `bitcoin-cli -named`. Each produces the same filtering results as its camelCase counterpart. Supplying both spellings is rejected in both forms. In `query_options`, the error says “Do not set both.” With `-named`, it reports “Unknown named parameter” for the camelCase alias, consistent with the generic named-argument handling already used by existing aliases.

```text
snake_case          camelCase         query_options  -named  both spellings
minimum_amount      minimumAmount     same results   same    rejected
maximum_amount      maximumAmount     same results   same    rejected
maximum_count       maximumCount      same results   same    rejected
minimum_sum_amount  minimumSumAmount  same results   same    rejected
```

Also checked `fundrawtransaction` with `change_position` and `changePosition`: behaviour matches master, including the error when both are supplied.
